project_title: Polymarket Multi-Asset Short-Term Up/Down Opportunity Optimizer
archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical Minimalism & Data Precision)

color_palette.forbidden_colors_alert: DO NOT use #1B93A4 (Teal Blue) or #7351B7 (AI Purple).

layout_and_grid.mode: MODE B: High Density Tactical Dashboard

sections_mapping.top_nav: Fixed z-50 glassmorphism header (bg-[#080B11]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10 px-6 py-3.5) with live asset selector [BTC 5M, ETH 5M, SOL 5M], status badges [WebSocket Freshness, Feed Delay ms, Order Book Depth, Paper Trading Active], and Real Trading Lock Toggle.
sections_mapping.hero_optimizer_decision_banner: col-span-12 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900/90 via-cyan-950/40 to-slate-900/90 border-2 border-cyan-500/40 p-6 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(6,182,212,0.15)] relative overflow-hidden
sections_mapping.budget_capital_bar: col-span-12 md:col-span-4 rounded-xl bg-[#0F141C] border border-white/10 p-5 space-y-4
sections_mapping.objective_selector: col-span-12 md:col-span-8 rounded-xl bg-[#0F141C] border border-white/10 p-5 space-y-4
sections_mapping.payoff_and_allocation_matrix: col-span-12 lg:col-span-7 rounded-xl bg-[#0F141C] border border-white/10 p-5 space-y-4
sections_mapping.execution_action_card: col-span-12 lg:col-span-5 rounded-xl bg-[#0F141C] border-2 border-emerald-500/30 p-5 space-y-5 relative
sections_mapping.depth_and_raw_orderbook_expandable: col-span-12 rounded-xl bg-[#0F141C] border border-white/10 p-5 space-y-4
sections_mapping.paper_execution_and_positions: col-span-12 rounded-xl bg-[#0F141C] border border-white/10 p-5 space-y-4

decision_banner.description: 1-second decision hero badge showing clear trade verdict ('RECOMMENDED BUY', 'NO TRADE VALID', or 'NEUTRAL HEDGE'). Displays instant summary of DEPLOYED vs CASH, expected payout range, and worst-case vs best-case scenario.

market_selector_tabs.description: Tabs for BTC 5M, ETH 5M, SOL 5M with live countdown timer to market rollover (e.g. 03:42), current spot index price, and 5M trend volatility.

capital_controls_widget.description: Capital pool inputs (Max Available Capital budget slider/input, Deployed Capital, Unspent Cash). Highlight that budget pool is total available capital and NOT mandatory trade size.

objective_selector_matrix.description: 5-way Objective Selector with toggle buttons: [Guaranteed Profit, Controlled Loss, Max Worst-Case Profit, Max Upside, Custom Risk]. Includes min yield % and max drawdown tolerance sliders.

allocation_and_payoff_details.description: Exact UP and DOWN split details: UP cost, DOWN cost, estimated execution fees, total debit, shares required, VWAP for UP/DOWN, and exact outcome payoffs (If UP wins profit +%, If DOWN wins profit +%).

execution_cta.description: High-visibility primary action button: 'BUY RECOMMENDED TRADE [DEPLOY $X | KEEP $Y CASH]'. Supports paper execution mode instantly with confirmation toasts and order ID logging.

live_orderbook_and_feeds.description: WebSocket depth books, precision, min size, freshness (ms), rollover countdown, synchronization status, paper history log, and diagnostic telemetry.

image_urls.description: Dark mode cryptocurrency trading chart terminal display
Bitcoin and Ethereum coins on keyboard with trading indicators

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons have active scale effect (active:scale-[0.98]), clear highlight borders, and soft glow overlays.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Specific CSS transitions on opacity and color (transition-colors duration-150, transition-opacity duration-200). Explicitly NO 'transition: all' on transform elements.
motion_and_interactions.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for instant trade order execution feedback, market rollover warnings, and risk alerts.
motion_and_interactions.prefers_reduced_motion: Respect system accessibility settings using motion-safe responsive Tailwind utilities.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: All key operational controls, market switches, numerical displays, sliders, and execution CTAs MUST have explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.
testing_and_accessibility.apca_contrast: High contrast dark mode (APCA > 75) with bold text for figures and values.
testing_and_accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-400 focus:outline-none) on all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a decision-first dashboard where the core verdict (BUY / DO NOT TRADE) and exact UP/DOWN allocation can be evaluated in ~1 second.
Keep Budget Pool as maximum available capital and show that trade size is calculated strictly based on optimal payoff geometry, leaving remaining cash unspent.
Use JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono for all financial values, prices, shares, VWAP, and dollar amounts.
Use Barlow Condensed / Chivo / Cabinet Grotesk for section titles and hero action badges.
Ensure paper execution is enabled by default with real-time feedback, simulated order fills, PnL tracking, and position management.
Keep real trading locked behind missing credentials alert with a clear lock icon and toggle.
Include live WebSocket mock/real feed status, order book depth charts for UP and DOWN options, and 5-minute rollover countdowns for BTC, ETH, and SOL.
